turns.text: I need a set of matching plant-shop ads, and I’m probably overthinking how to explain this because I want them to feel like they belong together. I always worry that an ad can look lovely at first glance but become hard to read when you actually try to find the details. The formats I need are 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9, and the wording to include exactly is “Fern House”, “Weekend Plant Sale”, “20% off all indoor plants”, “Saturday & Sunday”, “Visit 24 Willow Lane”. Please use leafy plants and a clean green-and-cream look across the set. Keep every line easy to read in all three, especially the address, and rearrange things to fit rather than shrinking the whole design.

args.name: Fern House — Square Plant Sale Ad

style.prompt: Create a finished, exceptionally legible square advertisement for a refined neighborhood plant shop. Coordinated brand design: warm cream #F6F2E7 background, deep forest green #173F2B typography, sage accents, tasteful realistic leafy potted indoor plants (ferns, monstera, pothos) grouped along bottom corners, subtle botanical silhouettes near edges. Clean editorial graphic design, restrained, spacious, strong typographic hierarchy, generous safe margins. Keep the central text field entirely clear of plants. Render ONLY these five exact text lines, spelled perfectly, with no extra text: "Fern House" / "Weekend Plant Sale" / "20% off all indoor plants" / "Saturday & Sunday" / "Visit 24 Willow Lane". Use elegant bold serif for brand and headline, clean highly readable sans-serif for offer and details. Brand at top, headline below across two lines if needed, offer prominent, date below, address in a wide forest-green footer panel with large cream sans-serif lettering, ample padding. Address must be easy to find and read, not tiny fine print. Every required phrase must appear exactly once, no invented logos or text. Balanced green-and-cream botanical identity intended for a matching three-format ad campaign.
